# Using VIIRS Nightime Light (NTL) to Visualize the Impact of Winter Storms
## Feburary 2021 Power Outages in Texas 

```{r}
# Import libraries
library(here)
library(terra) # raster handling
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap) # map making
library(kableExtra) # table formatting
library(spData) # spatial data
library(spDataLarge) # spatial data
library(geodata) # spatial data
library(stars)
```

### Read in rasters for Feb 07 and Feb 16
```{r}
feb_07_1 <- rast("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif")
feb_07_2 <- rast("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif")
feb_07 <- merge(feb_07_1, feb_07_2)

feb_16_1 <- rast("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif")
feb_16_2 <- rast("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif")
feb_16 <- merge(feb_16_1, feb_16_2)

viirs <- merge(feb_07, feb_16)
```

### Read in buildings and roads datasets
```{r}
# Read in .gpkg's
buildings <- st_read('data/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg', query = "SELECT *
FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1
WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)
OR type in ('residential', 'apartments', 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')")

roads <- st_read('data/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg', query = "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'")
```

### Check CRS's!
```{r}
if((st_crs(crs(viirs)) == st_crs(crs(buildings))) & (st_crs(crs(viirs)) == st_crs(crs(roads))) & (st_crs(crs(buildings)) == st_crs(crs(roads)))){
    print("CRS's match!")
  }else{
    print("CRS's DO NOT match!")
    st_crs(crs(viirs))$epsg
    st_crs(crs(buildings))$epsg
    st_crs(crs(roads))$epsg
}
```

### Find the change in night lights intensity (presumably) caused by the storm
```{r}
difference <- feb_07 - feb_16
```

#### Reclassify by blackout
Assuming that any location that experienced a drop of more than 200 nW cm-2sr-1 experienced a blackout.
```{r}
# NTL Reclassification Matrix

ntl_rcl <- matrix(c(-Inf, 200, NA, # values -Inf to 200 = NA, no blackout
                    200, Inf, 1),  # values 200 or greater = 1, blackout
                    ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Apply reclassification
blackout_mask <- terra::classify(difference, rcl = ntl_rcl)
```

#### Vectorize the blackout mask
```{r}
houston <- ext(-96.5, -94.5, 29, 30.5)

blackout <- blackout_mask |> 
    crop(houston) |> 
    as.polygons(aggregate = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) |> 
    st_as_sf() |> 
    st_make_valid() |> 
    st_transform("EPSG:3083")
```

### Exclude highways from the cropped blackout mask
Exclude any locations within 200 meters of all highways in the Houston area.
```{r}
texas_highways <- st_transform(roads, "EPSG:3083")

highways_buffer <- st_buffer(texas_highways, dist = 200)
highways_union <- st_union(highways_buffer)

ntl_wo_highways <- st_difference(blackout, highways_union)
```

### Identify the number of homes likely impacted by blackouts
```{r}
texas_homes <- st_transform(buildings, "EPSG:3083")
blackout_homes <- st_filter(texas_homes, ntl_wo_highways, .predicate = st_intersects)
```

```{r}
tmap_mode("view")

ntl_roads_map <- tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap") +
    tm_shape(ntl_wo_highways) +
        tm_polygons(fill = "yellow", fill_alpha = 0.5, lwd = 0) +
    tm_shape(texas_homes) +
        tm_polygons(col = "pink") +
    tm_shape(blackout_homes) +
        tm_polygons(col = "red")
ntl_roads_map
```
